newsitem.title: FINLAND: Partek to redeem Aker's Sisu shrs.
newsitem.headline: Partek to redeem Aker's Sisu shrs.

text.p: Finnish cargo handling equipment and construction materials group Partek Oy Ab said on Tuesday it would redeem Norwegian holding company Aker RGI ASA's shares in its Oy Sisu Ab subsidiary.

"Partek has the right to redeem from...Aker...its 17.1 million Sisu shares at a price of 46.03 markka per share...a total of 785 million markka increased by the interest accumulated at the redemption date," Partek said in a statement.
The redemption would take place on August 18, it added.
The stake to be redeemed corresponds to 46.2 percent of Sisu's share capital. At present, Partek owns 53.8 percent of Sisu, it said.
"After the redemption Partek will own almost 100 percent of Sisu's shares," the company said.
The redemption offer to remaining shareholders had been extended, it said.
